operative_clauses.original_operative_text: SECTION 1. Establishment of Council. There is hereby established The National Council on Indian Opportunity (hereinafter referred to as the "Council"). The Council shall have membership as follows: The Vice President of the United States who shall be the chairman of the Council, the Secretary of the Interior, the Secretary of Agriculture, the Secretary of Commerce, the Secretary of Labor, the Secretary of Health, Education, and Welfare, the Secretary of Housing and Urban Development, the Director of the Office of Economic Opportunity, and six Indian leaders appointed by the President of the United States for terms of two years.

original_source.page_or_item: American Presidency Project web page (transcription; not an official edition); APP node 277401; common-crawl capture 2025-10-10T13:28:06Z; Sec. 1

operative_clauses.original_operative_text: SEC. 2. Functions of the Council. The Council shall:

original_source.page_or_item: American Presidency Project web page (transcription; not an official edition); APP node 277401; common-crawl capture 2025-10-10T13:28:06Z; Sec. 2 (lead-in)

operative_clauses.original_operative_text: (a) Encourage full use of Federal programs to benefit the Indian population, adapting them where necessary to be available to Indians on reservations in a meaningful way.

original_source.page_or_item: American Presidency Project web page (transcription; not an official edition); APP node 277401; common-crawl capture 2025-10-10T13:28:06Z; Sec. 2(a)

operative_clauses.original_operative_text: (b)Encourage interagency coordination and cooperation in carrying out Federal programs as they relate to Indians.

original_source.page_or_item: American Presidency Project web page (transcription; not an official edition); APP node 277401; common-crawl capture 2025-10-10T13:28:06Z; Sec. 2(b)

operative_clauses.original_operative_text: (c) Appraise the impact and progress of Federal programs for Indians.

original_source.page_or_item: American Presidency Project web page (transcription; not an official edition); APP node 277401; common-crawl capture 2025-10-10T13:28:06Z; Sec. 2(c)

operative_clauses.original_operative_text: (d) Suggest ways to improve such programs.

original_source.page_or_item: American Presidency Project web page (transcription; not an official edition); APP node 277401; common-crawl capture 2025-10-10T13:28:06Z; Sec. 2(d)

operative_clauses.original_operative_text: SEC. 3. Compensation and per diem. Members of the Council who are officers of the Federal government shall receive no additional compensation by reason of this order. Other members of the Council shall be entitled to receive compensation and travel expenses, including per diem in lieu of subsistence, as authorized by law for persons in the government service employed intermittently (5 U.S.C., §§ 3109, 5703).

original_source.page_or_item: American Presidency Project web page (transcription; not an official edition); APP node 277401; common-crawl capture 2025-10-10T13:28:06Z; Sec. 3

operative_clauses.original_operative_text: (a) Each Federal department and agency represented on the Council shall furnish such necessary assistance to the Council as may be authorized by section 214 of the Act of May 3, 1945, 59 Stat. 134 (31 U.S.C. 691), or other law. The Department of the Interior shall furnish necessary administrative services for the Council.

original_source.page_or_item: American Presidency Project web page (transcription; not an official edition); APP node 277401; common-crawl capture 2025-10-10T13:28:06Z; Sec. 4(a)

operative_clauses.original_operative_text: (b) The staff of the Council shall include an Executive Director, who shall be appointed by the chairman of the Council, and such other employees as may be necessary, who shall be assigned by the departments and agencies represented on the Council.

original_source.page_or_item: American Presidency Project web page (transcription; not an official edition); APP node 277401; common-crawl capture 2025-10-10T13:28:06Z; Sec. 4(b)

operative_clauses.original_operative_text: SEC. 5. Meetings. The Council shall meet on call of the chairman.
